_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a student studying in: - Class 11th or 12th (+2 level), or Graduate, Post Graduate, or Technical courses in a recognised institution. 1. The applicant should be enrolled in a school, college, university, or technical institution having an NSS Unit. 1. The applicant should be willing to participate in community service activities and camps. 1. The applicant should comply with NSS guidelines and complete the prescribed service hours.
